heroSummary: Henrico County Public Schools begins the 2026–27 school year with a staggered start on August 24–25, 2026. Grades 1–5, 6, and 9 attend Monday, August 24; grades 7, 8, 10, 11, and 12 begin Tuesday, August 25. Pre-K and kindergarten students follow school-specific group schedules. All students attend Wednesday, August 26. Spring Break runs March 29–April 2, and the scheduled last day is Friday, June 4, 2027.

customSections.content: Three calendar entries are especially easy to misread.

This is an end-of-quarter student half-day with flexible staff clerical time. It is not a full school holiday.
The scheduled last day is also a student half-day and the end of the fourth quarter.

customSections.label: Why Some Henrico Addresses Say “Richmond, VA”
customSections.content: Henrico County Public Schools and Richmond Public Schools are separate divisions with different calendars and attendance boundaries. A mailing address that says “Richmond, VA” does not by itself show which division serves a student. Some street addresses with a Richmond mailing city are located in Henrico County and are assigned to HCPS. Before using a district calendar for enrollment, transportation, or childcare planning, enter the full street address in the official HCPS School Locator. The locator, not the mailing city alone, identifies the zoned elementary, middle, and high schools.

calendarFaqs.q: When does HCPS start school in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: HCPS begins with a staggered start on August 24–25, 2026. Grades 1–5, 6, and 9 attend August 24; grades 7, 8, 10, 11, and 12 begin August 25. Pre-K and kindergarten students attend according to their elementary school's group plan. All students attend August 26.

calendarFaqs.q: How does the HCPS 2026–27 staggered start work?
calendarFaqs.a: On August 24, half of pre-K and kindergarten students attend with grades 1–5, 6, and 9. On August 25, the second half of pre-K and kindergarten attends, grades 7, 8, 10, 11, and 12 begin, and the August 24 grade groups return. All students attend August 26. Each elementary school publishes its own pre-K and kindergarten group assignments.

calendarFaqs.q: When is HCPS Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: HCPS Spring Break runs Monday, March 29, through Friday, April 2, 2027. Students return Monday, April 5.

calendarFaqs.q: When is HCPS Winter Break in 2026–27?
calendarFaqs.a: HCPS Winter Break runs December 21, 2026, through January 1, 2027. Schools reopen Monday, January 4.

calendarFaqs.q: When is HCPS Thanksgiving Break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: HCPS Thanksgiving Break is Wednesday through Friday, November 25–27, 2026. Monday, November 23, and Tuesday, November 24, are regular school days.

calendarFaqs.q: Is March 26, 2027, a full day of school in HCPS?
calendarFaqs.a: No. March 26 is an end-of-quarter student half-day with flexible staff clerical time. It is not a full school holiday.

calendarFaqs.q: How do I find my assigned Henrico County school?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official HCPS School Locator and enter the full street address. School assignment follows attendance boundaries, not the mailing city or ZIP code alone.

calendarFaqs.q: Is HCPS the same as Richmond Public Schools?
calendarFaqs.a: No. HCPS serves Henrico County, while Richmond Public Schools serves the City of Richmond. Some Henrico addresses use 'Richmond, VA' as the mailing city, so confirm the school division with the HCPS School Locator.

calendarFaqs.q: Where can I get the official HCPS 2026–27 calendar PDF?
calendarFaqs.a: Use the official PDF link in the Downloads section on this page. HCPS's Back to School page provides the latest staggered-start details and school-specific pre-K and kindergarten plans.

sourceReviewDetailsTitle: How we verified the HCPS calendar
sourceReviewDetails: The instructional calendar PDF is marked updated April 22, 2026. It provides districtwide holidays, student half-days, breaks, quarter endings, and the scheduled last day.

For pre-K and kindergarten group assignments, we follow HCPS's July 27 staggered-start update and current Back to School guidance; families should confirm their assigned day with their elementary school.
The PDF labels March 26 as an end-of-quarter student half-day with flexible staff clerical time, not as a full school holiday.
Return dates after Thanksgiving, Winter Break, and Spring Break are based on the published student calendar.
Individual schools may publish group assignments, bell times, testing dates, athletics, and other school-specific events.
